concept_definition.trigger: An owner chooses a file and recipient
concept_definition.outcome: Each named recipient can read while their own grant is active

concept_definition.meaning: Store the uploaded file and its owner locally
Activate one selected recipient grant while retaining all other grants
Read only while the selected recipient has a current grant
Deactivate only the selected recipient grant
